candidates.change_summary: Change transfer to call with gas stipend to avoid revert on failure, altering balance distribution.
Replace transfer with selfdestruct to destroy contract and send balance, changing withdraw behavior.
Delete the require statement so anyone can call withdraw, changing access control.
Replace Owner with adr from multiplicate, but keep signature; change recipient to a default address.
Replace function call 'adr.call{value: msg.value}(data)' with 'adr.call{value: address(this).balance}(data)'
Delete the require statement that checks msg.sender is Owner
